payload.claim: The docstring says the merge-base candidate is used "only when this layer's pushed head was not already merged into it", naming one guard. The code at lines 217-223 actually requires two conditions: `_is_ancestor(mirror, own_parent, merge_base)` is true AND `_is_ancestor(mirror, pushed_sha, merge_base)` is false. The first condition is what makes a layer rebased below its own build commit (the "rebased" acceptance scenario) fail containment and raise, rather than silently picking an unrelated merge base. A reader of this docstring would believe only the second condition governs the choice and could remove the first as apparently redundant, which would silently break detection of a layer rebased below its build commit.
